discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 work has won the Lasker (2024), Breakthrough Prize and Gairdner, and it has had a large clinical and public-health impact on metabolic disease. It has not been honoured yet, and the 2025 prize went to immune tolerance, so a metabolism and physiology topic is well placed for 2026.
